description: Send a follow-up email about one application from the user's connected Gmail or Outlook, under the user's name, then record it on the application. It sends a real email to the address in to and cannot be undone. Pass application_id, to (the recipient's address as the user gave it, never a guess), subject and body (20 to 4,000 characters, the exact text the user approved). Send only on the user's explicit go-ahead: show the exact subject and text first, then send it only after they say yes to that text. Sending needs a connected Gmail or Outlook; without one, nothing is sent, the user sends it themselves, and you record it with getmattered_record_follow_up. On a timeout or an error, call getmattered_list_sent_follow_ups before sending again. Do not use it to answer an email an employer sent; use getmattered_reply_to_email. Next: getmattered_get_inbox for the employer's answer.

application_id.description: The application, from getmattered_list_due_follow_ups or getmattered_get_applications.

body.description: The message text, 20 to 4,000 characters: the exact text the user approved.

confirm_token.description: The token from a previous call that returned confirmation_required. Pass it only after the user said yes to that exact email, with the same arguments. It works once, for 10 minutes.

subject.description: The subject line the user approved.

to.description: The recipient's email address, exactly as the user gave it. Never guess one.

name: getmattered_send_follow_up

action.description: The operation that ran: list, history, draft, send or record_sent.

confirmToken.description: From getmattered_send_follow_up when nothing was sent yet: show the user the email, then pass this as confirm_token with the same arguments after their yes. Works once, for 10 minutes.

channel.description: email, linkedin or other: where the message should go.

draft.description: From getmattered_draft_follow_up: the drafted message. Nothing was sent.

applicationId.description: Pass as application_id to getmattered_draft_follow_up, getmattered_send_follow_up or getmattered_record_follow_up.

followUps.description: From getmattered_list_due_follow_ups: applications whose follow-up is due, most urgent first.

history.description: From getmattered_list_sent_follow_ups: follow-ups already sent, newest first.

nextCursor.description: From getmattered_list_sent_follow_ups: pass as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation and nothing was sent.

recorded.description: From getmattered_send_follow_up or getmattered_record_follow_up: the follow-up count after it was recorded.

title: Send a Follow-up Email
